title: Entropy-Memorization Law: Evaluating Memorization Difficulty of Data in LLMs
reasoning: The paper conducts a semantic evaluation of Large Language Models (LLMs) by categorizing data into semantic clusters and analyzing memorization behavior. This analysis specifically includes and evaluates clusters for 'Religious and Biblical Texts' (Cluster 2) and 'Spiritual and Religious Beliefs' (Cluster 6), providing dedicated results and correlation plots for these categories.
